description: Stage 2 mints the plan id from int(time.time()) in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/planner.py (plan_seq) and checks it only against taken_plan_ids for the flow's own intent branch prefix (entrypoint/taken_ids.py). Two flows started in the same second get disjoint prefixes, so both mint the identical plan id (for example P-1795584464-CLA-CO5.5 and P-1795567904-ANA-G4N), and holon-knowledge/ledger/plans.jsonl on main already holds five duplicate plan_id values. Calibration and ledger lookups keyed by plan id then attribute one flow's rows to the other.
goal: A plan id is distinct from every plan id already used anywhere in the repository (the plans ledger, the pending plan fragments and the remote P-* branches of every flow), and two Stage 2 runs in the same second with different intent slugs mint different plan ids. Reuse build_stage_disambiguator from ledger/rows.py or extend taken_plan_ids to cover all flows, whichever keeps the plan id format that existing parsers accept and the branch segment within ensure_stage_segment_fits. The root intent id built in entrypoint/intent_creator.py also gets the per-flow disambiguation only if that keeps the intent branch format valid for existing parsers; otherwise leave it, since the slug already keeps it distinct. Review iteration and calibration ids (REV-ITR-*, CAL-*) are out of scope. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, put new logic in a new small module where a touched module has no headroom, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: A plan id that is unique only within one flow's branch prefix breaks every lookup keyed by plan id once flows run concurrently.
acceptance_criteria: Two plan-id mints in the same second for different intent slugs, with disjoint intent branch prefixes, return different plan ids.
A plan id already present in the plans ledger, a pending plan fragment or a remote P-* branch of another flow is never minted again.
The plan id still matches the format the existing parsers and branch-length checks accept, and the plan branch stays within ensure_stage_segment_fits.
The public names of the touched modules are unchanged and no other source file changes.
The new test file uses fakes or a real temporary git repository, fails on the old code and passes on the new.
The module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for the new test file and the existing planner and taken-ids tests.
